reason: The frozen full-function report computed histgb_all predictions and unpaired metrics but omitted ribokinetic_all versus histgb_all from paired comparisons. histgb_all had the best sequence-OOD point estimates among the three non-neural feature baselines.
scientific_scope: Retrospective fairness diagnostic on cross-protein nonsynonymous Boël function prediction; not fixed-protein synonymous mechanism evidence and not a new preregistered RK-G1 gate.
allowed_actions: Reuse frozen source data, split assignments, ribokinetic_all predictions and histgb_all predictions.
Recompute aligned point metrics and paired operational-protein-cluster bootstrap deltas.
Report sequence-OOD and retained-test diagnostics with two metrics per partition.
forbidden_actions: No model fitting, checkpoint selection, feature selection, hyperparameter search or data-split change.
No access to functional untouched data.
No replacement of the original preregistered comparison or retroactive claim of preregistration.
No generator training, SOTA claim or fixed-protein mechanism claim.
decision_rule: A diagnostic favors ribokinetic_all only when Spearman delta CI is entirely above zero and cluster-balanced MSE delta CI is entirely below zero with Holm p<0.05. Failure favors neither a new mechanism claim nor generator authorization.
original_gate_handling: Preserve original rk_g1_pass=false regardless of this diagnostic.
